senses.gloss: m. (צָמַח) [grown over, sub. אזנים,] a person without (or with very small) auricles.
units: ib. 16 צ׳ כל שאין לו אזנים (ed. Zuck. צומוס, corr. acc.) a tsummaḥ is an animal which has no external ears; Bekh. VII, 4 (44ᵃ) צמע (Bab. ed. צומע, Ar. צימח), expl. שאזניו קטנות.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44a">Ib.</cite> (in G’mara) <cite ref="R00380"><he>צימע</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="R00204"><he>צומע</he></cite>.—[V. <cite ref="R00377"><he>צִימֵּחַ</he></cite>.]
